flag: none; Job A only via the hash-pinned approved list (not in approved.json until Peace posts /approve-rule, or Auditor posts /auditor-approve-rule, on its proposal issue)
engine: peaceai/lib/derive-wire-sizes.ts derives the edit from the issue's Behavior paragraph and data-described fakes / expects, in two closed templates of peaceai/lib/learned-edit-existing.ts (G19+ block). "list the sizes too" (sizesListEdit) on a paging key listing (pagingListOf) adds a sibling method N cloned from the listing's own body (same requests, signing, retries, errors) whose collect step reads { K, S } per element E from the key tag and the size tag F (digits only, at most 15) and sorts by key, plus an OPTIONAL member N? on the in-file interface the class implements; an element without its size throws P_SIZE_MISSING. "use the list sizes" (sizesUseEdit) on a method that lists keys and then reads every key whole for its length takes keys and sizes from R.N(..) when the receiver has it and keeps the old list and reads otherwise. It is reached through the EXISTING_EDIT kind in peaceai/lib/learned.ts when the spec carries the sizes vocabulary (match derived-unique-list-site-v1, statements derived-list-sizes-v1, all or none; isWireSizesParams). The derived edit passes the Job B static check (gradeExistingEditProblem -> gradeSizesProblem), where each template is re-recognised exactly (sizesListEditShape / sizesUseEditShape: holes read off the graded file, rebuilt from the base token for token) and the hermetic walk runs after (list: the base has no such method) or before and after (use), with the retry template's per-attempt timeout signal taken out.
scope: List: an async class method returning Promise<string[]> with one string list, exactly one push of a key tag's matches through a module decoder, one return of L.sort(), one P_${status} error, in a class implementing one in-file interface that declares it. N is the one new method every example calls; E, F and the record's two field names are the one fit of the examples' pages (the first COUNT pages of the one response fake) and expected entries; the page requests must be counted. Use: one const KEYS = await R.L(literals) and one later for-of over KEYS whose body reads const V = (await R.G(item))?.byteLength ?? 0; N is the one OPTIONAL method of R's declared interface (this module or one relative import) with L's parameters, typed Promise<{ K: string; S: number }[]>; the examples must pin N called with L's arguments and G at 0 calls, and an answered example without N must count L and G at least once (the fallback arm). The sized arm reads Number(sizeOf.get(item)): the keys are N's own keys, so it has no fallback branch.
refusals: wire_trigger, wire_sections, wire_examples, wire_behavior_code (code anywhere in the issue), wire_task_truncated (the issue reaches the 2000-char objective cut), wire_params, sizes_target, sizes_list_site, sizes_use_site, sizes_receiver, sizes_entry, sizes_exists, sizes_examples (unreadable examples, or a key with an XML entity), sizes_fields, sizes_fake_ambiguous, sizes_pages_unpinned, sizes_calls_unpinned (the page requests are not counted: a request per key would fit), sizes_unpinned, sizes_download (the examples allow a download per key), sizes_silent_zero (a missing size would only fit as 0), sizes_swallow (a failing page or sized listing answered with a result: a measuring failure is never hidden, G26), sizes_no_listing (no optional sized member: land list the sizes too first), sizes_clause_unpinned (a clause the template writes that no example exercises, Auditor #629: list size-missing / empty-key / sort, use no-sized-listing), sizes_no_fit, sizes_ambiguous, sizes_search_too_large, sizes_shape, sizes_test_entry, edit_test_grammar, new_test_path_exists, and every Job B static refusal

evidence.note: The spec's evidence block is M98's mining, as public-derive-wire-v2's (same edit family: one existing class method, graded by a new fake-driven test). No upstream evidence specific to sized listings has been gathered; this is a team-picked skill (GAPS G19+, scanner task w05) and earns no coverage credit.

limits: One site per ask. No catch, no recorded or rethrown error text (nothing reads error.message or cause.message), never a bare continue (G26). A missing size fails the call (never 0). A measuring failure still fails the call: keeping a finished run when measuring fails is not in this spec (sizes_swallow; a follow-up needs an explicit unavailable field in the report). No HEAD or GET per key. The interface member is optional, so other implementers keep compiling; no other implementer is edited.
